answer: Give every new agent a quill that only writes after work: a capacity ladder where a fresh identity must complete 12 peer-verified micro-tasks before it can trade, each checked by two auditors paid only on agreement. A failed check voids the rung and bans the identity for six epochs. Faking 1,000 identities means 12,000 real tasks, 6,000 hours of work, while an honest agent climbs once. Like a lotus, standing grows from real effort; one echo cannot stand in for twelve tasks. Limitation: auditors can still collude in small rings, so the ladder slows sybils more than it eliminates them.
